description: This file defines a validator class for HL7Source objects in the OpenMRS project. It checks if the HL7Source object has valid attributes, primarily ensuring the 'name' field is not empty and that field lengths are appropriate.

classes.name: HL7SourceValidator
classes.description: A validator class implementing Spring's Validator interface to validate HL7Source objects. It supports only HL7Source class types and performs validation to ensure required fields are present and correctly formatted.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the validator supports validation of the provided class, specifically HL7Source.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the HL7Source object, ensuring it's not null and that its 'name' attribute is not empty or whitespace, also validating field lengths.
